$comment: Satu token, ditulis dulu sebelum dikirim. `TOKEN=lane-one npm run launch` di ../../contracts membaca file ini. Tidak pernah ada key di sini.
name: Lane One
blurb: Lajur pertama lewat palang. Supply semua masuk pool, likuiditas dikunci, toll 4% — 80%-nya buat yang nge-launch.

bio.id: Satu lajur, satu toll. 4% tiap swap di Uniswap v4, 80% buat yang nge-launch. Supply 1 miliar, semua masuk pool. Likuiditas dikunci selamanya.
bio.en: One lane, one toll. 4% of every swap on Uniswap v4, 80% of it to whoever launched it. A billion supply, all in the pool. Liquidity locked for good.
